retrieval.rag_summary: Acoustica Acoustic Barrier represents flexible, high-density mass-loaded acoustic barrier membranes engineered to dramatically reduce airborne sound transmission across walls, ceilings, and roofs. Formulated to provide high acoustic transmission loss (Rw) and vibration damping without adding substantial wall thickness, these membranes stop speech, entertainment, traffic, and aircraft noise. They are commonly incorporated into drywall partitions, ceiling cavities, and timber floor-ceiling assemblies in residential, commercial, and studio environments.
